tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the businesses listed on Localstreet by trade or name.

tools.name: business_details
tools.description: One listed business: trade, address, phone, opening hours, open now, whether it takes callback requests.

tools.name: events_on
tools.description: What's on in the visitor's borough on a day (today, tomorrow, weekend, week, or yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: schools_near
tools.description: Schools in the visitor's area from our hub data (Ofsted, phase, faith character, address), nearest first.

tools.name: catchment_check
tools.description: Whether a postcode was inside a school's last admissions distance. Says when that data is not available yet.

tools.name: noticeboard_search
tools.description: Live posts on the borough's noticeboard (for sale, free, wanted, local help).

tools.name: area_now
tools.description: What is happening in the area right now: tube and rail status, bus disruption, serious roadworks, flood warnings, air quality and police events, with how fresh each is.

tools.name: fuel_prices_near
tools.description: Fuel prices at forecourts near a UK postcode or place, from the government's Fuel Finder data (updated every 15 minutes), in two orders: lowest pump price, and best value for the driver (the pump price plus the fuel used driving there and back, from the car's mpg and how many litres they buy). Says

tools.name: fuel_station
tools.description: One forecourt's prices for every fuel it sells, when each was last updated, and its facilities, found by name near a UK postcode or place (Fuel Finder).

tools.name: fuel_area_trend
tools.description: How fuel prices in a UK postcode district moved day by day: the lowest and the average price each day (Fuel Finder).

tools.name: hygiene_rating
tools.description: A food business's food hygiene rating from the Food Standards Agency, with the date of the inspection, found by name and optionally a UK postcode or place.

tools.name: hygiene_near
tools.description: Food hygiene ratings of food businesses near a UK postcode or place (Food Standards Agency), nearest first, each with its inspection date. Can keep to one kind of business or a minimum rating.

tools.name: pharmacy_open_now
tools.description: Pharmacies open right now near a postcode or place in England, nearest first, with the time each closes. On a bank holiday it uses the NHS rota, or says the rota is not published yet. From the NHSBSA pharmacy list.

tools.name: pharmacy_hours
tools.description: A pharmacy's opening hours for each day of the week, and whether it is open now, found by name near a postcode or place in England (NHSBSA pharmacy list).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "area_now" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What is happening in the area right now: line disruption and flood warnings, with how fresh each is." → after: "What is happening in the area right now: tube and rail status, bus disruption, serious roadworks, flood warnings, air quality and police events, with how fresh each is."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
